title: Compliance reporting pack generator (v1) — assemble customer-ready artifacts + evidence snapshots
creator: Talia Benson
project: Enterprise Security & Compliance Foundation: Retention controls + compliance reporting pack
description:
## Summary
Build a repeatable generator (CLI script first; service later if needed) that assembles the baseline “Compliance Reporting Pack v1” into a customer-ready bundle and captures immutable evidence snapshots for SOC2/ISO-aligned audits.

This ticket covers the implementation of the generator + packaging, not the authoring of the compliance narrative itself.

## Background / Why
Enterprise prospects are asking for a retention/audit logging “packet” that can be shared in security reviews (and we need the same material internally as evidence). Today the content is spread across Confluence pages, spreadsheets, console screenshots, and ad-hoc exports.

Generator goals:
- Reduce time to respond to security reviews (target: < 30 minutes to generate a complete pack)
- Ensure reproducible outputs (same inputs => same artifact hashes)
- Capture evidence snapshots with provenance (timestamps, source pointers, and signer)

## Scope
### In scope (v1)
1) Generate customer-facing bundle (zip) containing:
- PDF (or HTML + PDF) version of the pack (Confluence-sourced narrative + tables)
- Control-to-evidence matrix (CSV + PDF)
- Retention policy attestations (effective policy summary + guardrails statement)
- Audit log coverage summary (what events are captured; where; how exported)
- “How to validate retention enforcement” appendix (safe, non-tenant-specific where possible)

2) Generate internal evidence snapshot bundle (zip) containing:
- Snapshot metadata manifest (run id, timestamps, environment, operator)
- Pull of “effective retention policy” for selected tenant(s)/environment(s)
- Last N days of retention enforcement job status metrics (aggregated)
- Redacted audit sample for “policy change” event (admin action)
- References (URLs/commit SHAs) to the exact source docs used

3) Provide a single entrypoint:
- CLI: `rw-compliance-pack generate --tenant <id> --env hosted|dedicated|private --region <region> --output <dir> [--customer-facing] [--internal-evidence]`

### Out of scope (v1)
- Fully automated “service” with UI button in Console (track as follow-up)
- Automatic collection of every eligible datastore’s raw retention state
- Tenant-specific raw inference payload retention content (explicitly excluded from v1 scope)

## Assumptions
- Evidence sources exist by the time we ship (at least partial):
  - Retention effective-policy API endpoint (ENG-2926)
  - Enforcement job dashboards/metrics (ENG-2944)
  - Legal hold / exception flags exposed to the policy engine (ENG-2934)

## Proposed design
### Architecture
- Repo location: `redwood` monorepo under `tools/compliance_pack/` (Python) OR `internal-tooling/compliance-pack` (separate) depending on secrets/permissions. Preference: monorepo with restricted access.
- Output format:
  - `compliance_pack_<tenant>_<env>_<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>_<runid>.zip`
  - Contains `/customer/` and `/evidence/` directories (if both requested)

### Inputs / sources
- Confluence-exported markdown/HTML (pinned version) for:
  - Compliance reporting pack v1 outline
  - Control mapping (retention + audit logging)
  - Audit log retention + exports behavior
  - Retention controls overview
- Programmatic pulls:
  - Control plane API: effective retention policy for tenant + env + region
  - Audit log exporter: metadata about export boundaries and retention warnings
  - Observability: time-windowed metrics for enforcement runs (delete throughput, lag, error rate)

### Rendering
- Convert markdown to PDF via `pandoc` (preferred; stable + supports templates) with a Redwood-branded template.
- All generated PDFs include a footer:
  - Pack version (v1)
  - Generation timestamp (UTC)
  - Run ID
  - Source doc version pointers (Confluence page version + SHA of generator)

### Redaction / safety
- Customer-facing bundle must not include:
  - Internal-only URLs (Grafana internal, raw incident links)
  - Tenant IDs (unless the request is explicitly tenant-specific and approved)
  - Non-public model names, capacity identifiers, or infrastructure hostnames
- Evidence bundle may include internal URLs but must be stored in an access-controlled location.

### Provenance + integrity
- Emit `manifest.json` (flat JSON) with:
  - generator git SHA
  - list of inputs with versions (Confluence page version, API endpoints called)
  - hashes of generated artifacts (sha256)
- Optional signing (follow-up): GPG signing by GRC operator.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Running generator in staging produces a complete customer-facing zip with:
  - a single PDF for the narrative
  - CSV export of the control-to-evidence matrix
  - retention policy summary table
  - audit logging coverage summary
- [ ] Running generator with `--internal-evidence` produces evidence zip with manifest + hashes.
- [ ] Generator includes a “no secrets” mode that validates redaction checks for customer-facing outputs.
- [ ] Unit tests cover:
  - manifest generation + deterministic sorting
  - template rendering
  - redaction rules
- [ ] Documentation: `README.md` with step-by-step for Sales/SE + GRC on how to generate.

## Implementation plan
1) Define pack content contract (file list + naming) with Olga (GRC) + Naomi (PM)
2) Implement fetchers:
   - Confluence export fetch (manual input folder for v1 acceptable)
   - Control plane effective policy fetch (requires ENG-2926)
   - Metrics fetch (requires ENG-2944; fallback to CSV export if API not ready)
3) Implement renderer + template
4) Add redaction pass + allowlist
5) Add CI lint/test
6) Pilot with one prospect flow (Support/Sales enablement) and adjust

## Open questions
- Do we need a strict “customer pack” vs “internal evidence pack” separation as two commands (e.g. `generate-customer`, `generate-evidence`) to avoid accidental sharing?
- Where should generated artifacts live (Drive folder vs secured S3 bucket)? Need a default that works for GRC and Sales.
- What is the update cadence for the narrative content (monthly vs per release)? How do we enforce “pinned doc versions”?

## Links
- Confluence (target sources):
  - /security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/compliance-reporting-pack-v1
  - /security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/control-mapping-retention-and-audit-logging
  - /security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-log-retention-and-exports
  - /security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/retention-controls-overview
- Related Linear:
  - PM-482 (initiative)
  - ENG-2926 (Console backend endpoints for retention settings)
  - ENG-2934 (Legal hold + exception flags)
  - ENG-2944 (Dashboards and alerts for retention enforcement)

## Risks
- Confluence export stability: formatting may change across page edits; must pin versions and/or snapshot source markdown.
- Permissioning: generator needs access to tenant effective-policy endpoints + metrics; ensure least-privilege tokens.
- Redaction failures: add automated checks and require explicit flag to include internal evidence materials.
